user.title: Authentication type
user.description: Choose the Domonap profile. The existing phone/SMS flow remains unchanged; Rubetek Panel uses a separate authentication profile.

data_description.auth_mode: phone — phone number + SMS; panel — Rubetek/AOSP panel

panel_setup.title: Rubetek panel setup
panel_setup.description: A new activation code can be exchanged for a panel session once. If the panel is already activated, an existing session can be imported without reusing the code.

panel.title: Rubetek panel activation
panel.description: Enter the 8-digit panel activation code. The code is used only to obtain the panel session and is not stored in Home Assistant.

panel_session.title: Import existing panel session
panel_session.description: Paste JSON containing instanceId, deviceInfo, panel and completeToken. This does not use an activation code.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Domonap needs to re-authenticate this integration. Continue to send a confirmation code to the saved phone number.
